COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   B. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   D. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.
   C. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.

7. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   B. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.
   D. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   C. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

   A. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.
